text_block_list.text:
After training, I spotted some horse girls 
exchanging opinions on the track.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
We were all just talking about what counts 
as the 'classic, textbook sports 
training'!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I think stuff like getting stronger from 
wiping car windows is super cool! Like 
turning your daily routine into training, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Bunny hops! That level of sheer grit 
has gotta be the king of classic sports 
training, desu!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I think studying tactics is a classic too! 
To win in sports, you've got to build up 
your knowledge as well!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
What about you, Trainer? What comes to 
mind when you think of classic sports 
training?
choice_data_list: A study session to secure victory
Building stamina as part of daily life

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Knowledge really is important after all! 
All right, let's try it out right away!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Look at that magnificent stride! Whoa... 
Teio-san really is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heheh~♪ For the invincible Teio-sama, this 
is an absolute breeze!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All right! Next, let's watch Spe-san's 
race! Which one should we pick~?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Eh, m-mine too, desu? That's kinda 
embarrassing... ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehh!? Mine's over already!? But I have so 
many more recommendations to show!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, you totally get it! All right then, 
let's get down to practice!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hup, hop, hah! —Wah!? Look at all those 
musical notes, desu!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
H-Hang in there, Spe-san! You're almost at 
a game clear!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Having fun playing a dance game together 
while training our legs and core! Isn't 
this the ultimate training?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Training is supposed to be fun like 
this! Get it now?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Right! When you think classic, it's bunny 
hops, desu! Let's go test it out!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... T-That was so tough~~~! 
I thought these stairs would never end...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That was fantastic training! ...Shall 
we do one more round-trip?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
O-One more round-trip...!? Kita-chan, you 
sure have crazy amounts of guts...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No, let's take a break first! Actually, 
they sell really delicious ice cream 
around here, desu!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
............ Spe-chan, was that your real 
goal for coming here all along—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
*gasp* ...N-No way, of course not, desu! 
Ahaha...
